description: List all prices for a specific product.

access_token.description: CRM access token (optional — your connected CRM is used when omitted)

limit.description: Max number of prices to return

location_id.description: CRM sub-account location ID (optional — defaults to your connected location)

offset.description: Number of prices to skip for pagination

productId.description: The product ID to list prices for

name: crm_list_prices
